tasks.short: Determine causes of fires and ways in which they could have been prevented.

steps.what: Determine causes of fires from the burned scene
Judge the ways in which they could have been prevented

tasks.design: She determines the cause at the burned scene and judges which of those causes could have been prevented. No separate cause log is part of this task, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The cause is judged from the scene, and the prevention judgement follows that cause.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing removes the cause finding. The digest's document loop is for specifications and procedures in the automate set, not for judging why this fire started. A rule check of fire stopping on a building model is a different task.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to name the cause from the scene and judge whether it could have been prevented.
tasks.human_edge: Only she can match the burn pattern to a cause and say whether that cause could have been prevented.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still determines the cause at the scene and still judges how it could have been prevented.

reach.task: Hear which cause she determined and which could have been prevented
reach.learn: What at the scene still supports that cause

evidence.claim: Determining the cause of a fire from the scene, and judging whether it could have been prevented, stays with the fire protection engineer.

assumptions: The work starts at the burned scene and ends when she has judged whether the cause could have been prevented.
No structured field is added. There is no producer and no extraction fallback.
She determines the cause and the prevention judgement herself. That time stays.
No separate cause log is named in this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: Whether a fire investigator outside the company already named the cause before she arrives.
research_questions: Which causes does she determine herself, and which are already named before she sees the scene?

already_counted.description: She still determines the cause and judges whether it could have been prevented.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A cause an outside investigator already named is not her time. She still determines the cause and the prevention judgement. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop training materials and conduct training sessions on fire protection.

steps.what: Develop training materials on fire protection
conduct training sessions with the people who attend

tasks.design: She develops the training materials and conducts the fire protection session herself. No second materials pack is part of this task, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The session depends on materials she has already decided, and on people in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing removes the session. The digest's document loop is for specifications and procedures in the automate set, not for judging what this fire protection session must teach. She would still have to supply every protection point, and she still conducts the session.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to decide what the session teaches and conduct it with the people who attend.
tasks.human_edge: Only she can tell, in the room, whether the people attending have understood the protection point.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still develops the materials and still conducts the session.

reach.task: See which protection point the session still does not teach
reach.learn: Which fire protection point she chose to put in the materials

evidence.claim: Developing fire protection training materials and conducting the session stays with the fire protection engineer.

assumptions: The work starts when the session to be taught is known and ends when she has conducted it.
No structured field is added. There is no producer and no extraction fallback.
She writes the materials and conducts the session. That time stays.
No second materials pack is named in this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: Whether another trainer already wrote the materials she is asked to use.
research_questions: Which sessions use materials she writes, and which already exist before she is asked to conduct them?

already_counted.description: She still develops the materials and conducts the session.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Materials another trainer already wrote are not her time. She still develops what she teaches and still conducts the session. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study the relationships between ignition sources and materials to determine how fires start.

steps.what: Study relationships between ignition sources and materials
determine how fires start from those relationships

tasks.design: She studies how ignition sources and materials meet and determines how the fire starts. No separate ignition list is part of this task, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: How the fire starts is judged from the ignition source and the material, which she studies first.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing removes the study. The digest keeps research manual, and a rule check of fire stopping on a building model does not show how a material ignites. The amplify prior does not name a second entry this study already repeats.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to link the ignition source to the material and say how the fire starts.
tasks.human_edge: Only she can judge whether that source and that material actually meet in the way the records suggest.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still studies the ignition relationship and still determines how the fire starts.

reach.task: Hear how she says the fire starts
reach.learn: Which ignition source and which material she linked

evidence.claim: Studying how ignition sources and materials meet, and determining how the fire starts, stays with the fire protection engineer.

assumptions: The work starts with the ignition samples and ends when she has determined how the fire starts.
No structured field is added. There is no producer and no extraction fallback.
She studies the relationship and makes the start judgement. That time stays.
No separate ignition list is named in this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: Whether a laboratory already ran the ignition test she is asked to read.
research_questions: Which ignition tests does she study herself, and which results are already in hand before she starts?

already_counted.description: She still studies the relationship and determines how the fire starts.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: An ignition test a laboratory already ran is not her time. She still studies the relationship and still determines how the fire starts. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop plans for the prevention of destruction by fire, wind, and water.

steps.what: Develop plans for prevention of destruction by fire, wind, and water

tasks.design: She develops the prevention plan for fire, wind, and water herself. No second plan is part of this task, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan depends on the site and on which of fire, wind, and water can destroy it.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing removes the plan. The digest's document loop is for specifications and procedures in the automate set, not for judging which prevention this site needs. She would still have to supply the measures. Safety components in road traffic, water, gas, heating or electricity are a different case, and this plan is not that component.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to decide which measures prevent destruction by fire, wind, and water at that site.
tasks.human_edge: Only she can say which measure fits this site and which hazard the plan still misses.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still develops the prevention plan for fire, wind, and water.

reach.task: Use the prevention plan she developed
reach.learn: Which destruction the plan still does not cover

evidence.claim: Developing a plan that prevents destruction by fire, wind, and water stays with the fire protection engineer.
Safety components in road traffic, water, gas, heating or electricity are high-risk.

assumptions: The work starts with the site and ends when she has developed the prevention plan.
No structured field is added. There is no producer and no extraction fallback.
She develops the plan herself. That time stays.
No second plan is named in this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: Whether the site already has a prevention plan she is only asked to comment on.
research_questions: Which plans does she develop herself, and which already exist before she is asked?

already_counted.description: She still develops the prevention plan.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A prevention plan the site already holds is not her time. She still develops the plan this task names. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Causes, training, ignition studies, and prevention plans stay her week. She gains no right to name a cause the scene does not support or to skip the session.
skills_to_grow: Stop when the scene does not support the cause she is about to name.
Say which protection point a session still does not teach.
Refuse a prevention plan that ignores water when the site needs it.
role.ambitious_version: She still determines fire causes at the scene, still conducts the training, still studies how ignition and materials meet, and still develops the prevention plan. No remote fire scene.
